prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Turkish woman, an adult, in her early 40s, bold and confident expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large and statuesque woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy. A powerful, commanding build carrying great natural size throughout: broad strong shoulders, a full heavy bust, and continuing that same broad, continuous, solid silhouette, a high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly, larger and more dramatically rounded than an ordinary full-term pregnancy, projecting forward well beyond the line of her own chest, projects forward from her thick sturdy torso with no sharp transition anywhere, enormous broad hips and thighs beneath it. Thick strong arms, a full round face with a warm, regal bearing. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, warm olive skin, smoky bronze eyes, a deep rose-nude lip, deep burgundy wine-red hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real pores, real living eyes, ears bare, no piercings, wearing two to three pieces of silver earrings. Full body fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 diagonal bands by 2 parallel hazy transition zones running from the upper right to the lower left as seen by the camera, crossing the centre line of her figure about 28% of the way down her figure from the top and about 50% of the way down her figure from the top. Region 1 is everything on the upper side of the first diagonal transition zone: it carries koi scales (rounded smooth scales with fine visible growth rings, each scale glossy and slightly domed), BLAZING ELECTRIC CRIMSON scale formations, VIVID PEARL WHITE scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 2 is the diagonal band between transition zone 1 and transition zone 2: it carries butterfly scales (thousands of microscopic powder-fine scales layered like overlapping roof tiles, each scale individually distinct catching its own glint), BLAZING ELECTRIC EMERALD scale formations, VIVID GOLD scale-edge detail, every scale catching its own glint and casting its own small shadow. Region 3 is everything on the lower side of the last diagonal transition zone: it carries traditional irezumi tattoo ink, bold black ink outlines, firefly night formations in ELECTRIC INDIGO and GOLD, extreme high-gloss oil finish. The boundaries between regions are hazy and feathered — there is no visible line at all. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform wedges, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
